correctness.rationale: Original unrestricted uniqueness for n+1 prime/twice prime/8 read in Acharya full HTML. At three extra lengths n=8,11,15 two independent exhaustive exact-signature partitions cover 55,233,1597 admissible words and find only reversal orbits. The elementary factor lemma covers every remaining n; boundary-safe nonpalindromic s and t produce nonreversal 11-free interleavings with matching composition multisets by a direct all-interval category bijection. Tested additional 88 negative lengths. Assumption and finite/infinite proof boundary explicit.

The asserted mathematical content is the exact combined constrained characterization, not any known ingredient.

A complete all-length iff and precise exceptional finite set is more than a numerical census.
